accessories.primary: brass compass pendant on a dark leather cord, worn around the neck, always visible
accessories.secondary: rolled paper map (carried in scenes 1, 2, 4), leather satchel (scenes 2, 5)

asset_provenance.references: Reference images are generated with the platform's built-in image generation (platform-builtin-image), chained from the approved front reference; no external provider, no paid call, no credentials. Scene stills are generated the same way. All stills are animated locally with deterministic FFmpeg zoompan; they are labelled locally-animated-stills, never AI-generated video.
asset_provenance.scene_stills: platform-builtin-image, chained from the front reference, one distinct still per scene
asset_provenance.voice: voicestudio-omnivoice, non-commercial test voice, CC-BY-NC, seed 42

expressions.concentration: brows slightly drawn, lips closed, gaze fixed
expressions.determined: brows set, lips pressed, chin up
expressions.joy: broad smile, eyes crinkled at the corners
expressions.relief: soft smile, shoulders down, eyes half-closed
expressions.wonder: eyes wide, eyebrows raised, mouth slightly open

face.eyes: large dark-brown eyes, set wide apart, thick dark lashes, gentle upward curve at the outer corners
face.freckles: light freckle dusting across the nose and cheeks
face.mouth: full lips, gentle closed-mouth smile at rest
face.shape: round face, soft jawline, full cheeks

hair.style: shoulder-length bob with a straight fringe, side part on the left
hair.texture: smooth, slight wave at the ends

name: Mara
negative_constraints: No other hair color, length, or style.
No other jacket color; no dress, no uniform, no costume change.
No removal of the compass pendant.
No change of eye color, eye size, or eye spacing.
No photorealistic rendering of the character.
No second character in any scene.
No text, watermark, or logo inside any scene image.

outfit.description: ONE fixed outfit in every scene: deep teal chore jacket with brass buttons, worn open over a cream cotton t-shirt, dark indigo trousers, brown leather boots.
outfit.jacket: deep teal chore jacket, four brass buttons, two chest pockets, collar worn up at the back

props.compass: the brass compass pendant itself; in scene 1 it rests on the map table
props.map: rolled paper map, cream paper with hand-drawn ink coastlines
props.satchel: tan leather satchel with a brass clasp

provenance.design_source: CF-WO-P1-006-R1 build coordinator, 2026-11-27; fictional demonstration design, no user-supplied reference
provenance.image_generation: platform-builtin-image (built-in image generation of this environment; no external provider, no paid call, no credentials)
inferences: Exact hex 0F6B6B for deep teal is a production choice recorded here as CONFIRMED design, not an inference.
Boot and trouser details not visible in upper-body references are production inferences from the outfit description; they must match the full-body reference once generated.
Scene environments, lighting, and camera directions are production inferences in the shot list, not bible canon.

expressions.view: one sheet, six labelled expression portraits: neutral, wonder, determined, joy, concentration, relief

front.view: front, upper body, facing camera, neutral expression

full_body.view: full body, standing, front, whole outfit visible

side.view: side profile, upper body, facing left

three_quarter.view: three-quarter, upper body, head turned slightly left

registration_note: Fictional demonstration identity created for CF-WO-P1-006-R1 only. She is NOT an existing canonical user character, NOT registered in the global character registry, and must never be merged into it. Her data is project-local to examples/p1006-r1-character-consistency/ and the p1006-r1 delivery folder.

signature_color.appears_on: chore jacket (primary), compass cord accent in scene 6 only
signature_color.name: deep teal
signature_color.note: Defined once here. Every scene must show the deep teal jacket; no scene may change it to another color.

skin.appearance: smooth stylized skin, no blemishes, faint blush on the cheeks

style.note: Stylized 3D was chosen over photorealism because a simple, distinctive design is more reproducible across independent generations than a photoreal face.

visual_constraints: Face structure never changes: round face, wide-set large dark-brown eyes, small straight nose, freckles.
Hair never changes: dark auburn shoulder-length bob with straight fringe.
Outfit never changes: deep teal chore jacket, cream t-shirt, dark indigo trousers, brown boots.
Brass compass pendant visible in every scene.
Signature color deep teal (0F6B6B) present in every scene on the jacket.
Stylized 3D look in every scene; never switch to photorealism or a different style.
Body proportions constant: slim athletic build, average height.
